profiles.trustBoundary: Context7 MCP is advisory until a workflow records live MCP output; API keys must come from environment or client auth, never repository files.
profiles.repairHint: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY, then run npx ctx7 setup --mcp --codex --project --yes --api-key "$CONTEXT7_API_KEY".

profiles.trustBoundary: CLI docs output is advisory unless captured into a local evidence artifact and reviewed.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills list --universal and npx ctx7 docs /facebook/react "hooks" --json.

profiles.trustBoundary: UI/UX skill guidance may inform UI-lab templates; shadcn registry, Storybook, and Playwright remain readiness authority.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /anthropics/skills frontend-design --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: React pattern skill guidance is advisory; UI-lab registry metadata and package tests decide template readiness.
profiles.repairHint: Reinstall react-ui-patterns and base-ui-react through ctx7 skills install.

profiles.trustBoundary: Base UI guidance may inform accessible primitives; UI-lab registry metadata and tests remain readiness authority.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /secondsky/claude-skills base-ui-react --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: Browser skill guidance does not prove browser availability or live Playwright MCP calls.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /ruvnet/ruflo browser-test --universal --yes and validate Playwright separately.

profiles.trustBoundary: Context engineering skills are advisory input to Agentic Search metadata, not verifier authority.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /addyosmani/agent-skills context-engineering --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: MCP pattern skill may guide design but cannot grant MCP install/runtime authority.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /affaan-m/everything-claude-code mcp-server-patterns --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: Prompt skill guidance may improve packets and prompts; generated prompts remain reviewable drafts.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /davila7/claude-code-templates senior-prompt-engineer --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: Git workflow skill guidance cannot override Archon git guardrails or mutate branches without explicit operator action.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /bobmatnyc/claude-mpm-skills git-workflow --universal --yes.

profiles.trustBoundary: Story mapping skill may help BMAD epics/stories; BMAD readiness gates remain authoritative.
profiles.repairHint: Run npx ctx7 skills install /deanpeters/product-manager-skills user-story-mapping --universal --yes.
